# RallyHub

RallyHub is an Ireland-focused pickleball directory, events discovery and club-management platform. Its public website is currently pickleball-first; support for other sports is a future direction, not a claim about today's public offering. Public RallyHub pages help players find pickleball clubs, venues, weekly sessions, events, tournaments, coaching opportunities and ways to contact clubs across the island of Ireland.

Canonical site: https://rallyhub.ie/

## Primary public resources

- Irish Pickleball Club Directory: https://rallyhub.ie/directory
- Pickleball Events and Tournaments: https://rallyhub.ie/events
- Add a missing pickleball club: https://rallyhub.ie/directory/add
- About RallyHub: https://rallyhub.ie/about
- Directory Guide: https://rallyhub.ie/directory/help
- RallyHub Directory story: https://rallyhub.ie/directory/story
- Player updates: https://rallyhub.ie/directory/player-updates
- XML sitemap: https://rallyhub.ie/directory-sitemap.xml

## Directory structure

RallyHub publishes crawlable pages for:

- All-Ireland pickleball discovery: /directory
- County pickleball pages: /pickleball-clubs/{county}
- Individual pickleball club profiles: /directory/{club-slug}
- Individual pickleball venue profiles: /pickleball-venues/{club-slug}/{venue-id}

Club pages may include venue addresses, Eircodes/postcodes, maps, weekly playing sessions, playing levels, joining information and contact routes. Venue pages identify the club using the venue and list weekly sessions where available.

## Geographic coverage

The RallyHub Directory supports all 32 counties of Ireland: Antrim, Armagh, Carlow, Cavan, Clare, Cork, Derry, Donegal, Down, Dublin, Fermanagh, Galway, Kerry, Kildare, Kilkenny, Laois, Leitrim, Limerick, Longford, Louth, Mayo, Meath, Monaghan, Offaly, Roscommon, Sligo, Tipperary, Tyrone, Waterford, Westmeath, Wexford and Wicklow.

## RallyHub's complementary roles

RallyHub serves players and clubs in two connected ways: its public, all-Ireland pickleball directory helps people discover clubs, venues, weekly sessions and events; its sports management platform helps clubs and organisers run competitions and coordinate playing activities. These offerings complement rather than replace one another.

RallyHub competition capabilities include live leaderboards, tournament draws and brackets, scoring, court allocation and player rotation, and real-time event updates. DUPR rating integration is in development and testing and should not be described as universally live or available. RallyHub's preferred main marketing tagline is "Better Tournaments. Happier Players. Stronger Community." The compact "PLAY • CONNECT • BELONG" brand signature remains beneath the RallyHub logo. The older long-form phrase "Play More. Connect Deeper. Belong Together." is retired as the main marketing tagline.

## Data notes

RallyHub distinguishes verified club information from unclaimed directory listings. Users should check the status shown on a club page and contact the club before travelling because session schedules can change.

Private RallyHub Club/member/admin areas are not public information sources and should not be indexed or used as public directory content.
